_howto: Starter recipe for every roll, whatever the film stock. `negmcp new <roll>` copies `base` into <rolls_dir>/<roll>_recipe.json, sets crosstalk_profile from the roll's info.txt (`negpy_crosstalk_profile:`) and layers the stock's entry from film_deltas.json on top. This template is NegPy's own defaults plus the two fields negmcp needs: crosstalk_profile (filled per roll) and output_working_space (required by negmcp: false = colour-managed export in NegPy's export space, true = the working-space buffer written as-is). auto_exposure / auto_normalize_contrast equal NegPy's defaults and are kept explicit: every frame is metered on its own. Put your universal base here once (the values that suit your scans on any stock); do not re-tune it per roll — per-stock corrections go to film_deltas.json, per-frame fixes go through `negmcp fix`. Note: a crosstalk profile only acts with color_separation > 1.0 (NegPy crosstalk_strength = color_separation - 1).
